newsitem.title: JAPAN: Argentina mulling samurais next week - underwriters.
newsitem.headline: Argentina mulling samurais next week - underwriters.

text.p: Argentina is considering launching samurai bonds sometime next week with Nikko Securities lead-managing the issue, underwriters said on Friday.

"It's likely that Argentina will launch samurai bonds during the week starting on December 2," an underwriter said, adding that Argentina is expected to launch the bonds before December 6, when officials from that country are scheduled to meet investors and underwriters here.
Underwriters said the scale of the offer was expected to be about 50 billion yen and that it was expected to be a long-term bond.
